design: Normalize mean discovery MLP write difference endpoint1 minus endpoint0 for each family. Freeze four rank-one directions before validation. For every target pair project its true donor delta onto each source direction; test projected edit and complementary edit separately. This is teacher-informed span adequacy, not an encoder or independently predicted intervention.
controls: Identity, complete donor swap, fixed random rank-one projection, per-source +/- Gaussian edits matched to projected norm. Privileged generic readout control projects onto mean unembedding weight group1 minus group0 (not the exact downstream Jacobian).
metrics: Signed donor task-margin change; KL(full donor patch||candidate patch) and KL(native||candidate). Fidelity is relative to same-recipient full-write patch, not natural donor logits.
splits: Only discovery rows fit directions. Candidate lexical cohorts are not strictly vocabulary disjoint. Alternate-format native gate failures remain diagnostics. No whole-task training holdouts or reserved tests accessed.
hypotheses: Only sentiment and negation share a direction
Each task has a separate rank-one direction
Low rank predicts margins but misses distribution changes
A direct output-label contrast explains apparent transfer
Mean directions miss meaningful context-dependent subspaces
limits: Four discovery pairs per family; supervised directions; exact donor delta used for projection coefficients; no claim of unsupervised manifold or shared upstream computation.
